description: Makes a published Trial Reel's copy for followers: a new, ordinary Reel on the same account at its next free posting time, sent for approval when nothing blocks it. The copy starts from zero views; to keep the original's views, share the original in Instagram instead (trial_reel_open gives its link, Instagram's API can't share it). Marks the Trial Reel as gone to followers. Calling it again, even at the same moment, returns the same copy. Nothing publishes until a person approves it.

idempotency_key.description: Any unique string, e.g. a UUID. A retry with the same key within 24 hours returns the first call's result instead of doing it again.

name: trial_reel_share
title: Make a regular Reel copy
